title: Abspos static positions
units: CSS px relative to the container border box; results[mode][dir][dprN]; "=dpr1" means identical to the DPR 1 entry; an element without computed and specified has the DPR 1 entry's

a4-block-static.note: block-level abspos after a block: static position at the next block-start

a4-one-inset.note: abspos with top:5px only; other axis static

a4-inline-static.note: inline-level abspos inside text: static position at the inline position on the line

a4-inline-static-wrap.note: inline-level abspos at a line wrap

a4-shrink-to-fit.note: abspos with auto size shrinks to its text

a4-stretch.note: abspos with all insets and auto size stretches

a4-margin-auto-centre.note: abspos with insets 0 and auto margins centres

a4-orthogonal.note: horizontal-tb abspos with auto insets in the mode container

a4-padding-container.note: static position inside a padded, bordered container

a4-flex-static.note: abspos child of a centred flex container: static position is aligned

a4-margins.note: abspos with margins and one inset
